scope: Original client visual families, source modules and data catalogs; dynamic map/match instances are not individual assets. Full original scope is broader than the selected demonstration match.
assessmentRule: Transport readiness available does not mean an asset is authored or rendered. partial means an actual subset exists, not final showcase acceptance. No family is signed off at 1440p/144Hz.
audioFinding: No original client audio/media/font binaries, audio imports, AudioContext/new Audio/Phaser audio loading or sound playback were found in the source audit. SVGs and textures are generated in code; typography uses system fonts.
